generator.note: Kept local and frozen so trajectory continuations share the v1 substrate; only observers moved to hosted APIs.

corpus.selection: sort by sha256(path); first 80 calibration, next 24 heldout, next 12 trajectory

atlas.center_selection: first 32 calibration coordinates after frozen path-hash ordering

gate.notes: Same gate as model-backed A v1. Results remain descriptive until a threshold addendum is frozen before inspection.

deviation_notes: New manifest version per protocol.md ('Corrections require a new manifest version and explanation'). Observers are hosted API models instead of locally-run open weights: Gemini gemini-embedding-001 as reference and Jina jina-embeddings-v3 as an independent native coordinate system. Provider-side identifiers are recorded here and in every artifact; reproducibility therefore depends on provider behavior, not weight hashes. Corpus derivation, split rule, SRF dimension, trajectory parameters, generator revision, atlas construction, metrics and gate are identical to model_backed_a_v1.
